title: Ritham Feature Roadmap
summary: Product roadmap defining core features, novel differentiators, cross-generational design strategy, streak system design, and MVP/v2/moonshot prioritization for Ritham.
notes: Structured as feature tables, user-facing rationale, goals, and prioritization tiers (MVP/v2/moonshot) rather than a single locked architectural decision or an implementation contract — strongest signals align with PRD (feature requirements, scope, prioritization, user-facing framing). No ADR-style Decision/Consequences sections or SPEC-style API/schema definitions present.
